areas.name: Identity
areas.implemented: Real access keys, hashed sessions, role checks; OIDC SSO with actual Keycloak/browser verification, group mapping, token revocation, expiry, key rotation and restore boundary
areas.remaining: Production IdP configuration, organization identity policy, MFA enforcement and account lifecycle acceptance

areas.name: Isolation
areas.implemented: Per-installation organization binding, per-run grants, artifact/event/SSE/export access checks, protected settings; Docker-only secured command tools; pinned public-IP fetch and bounded capture
areas.remaining: Independent attack review, customer-specific role/connector/egress policy, permission lifecycle acceptance

areas.name: Execution
areas.implemented: Per-run budgets; durable single-host queue, idempotent acceptance, worker leases, interrupted-job review, recovery and actual local-LLM SIGKILL drill; requester-owned artifact requirements and bounded validation
areas.remaining: Workload/load acceptance, external-action retry policy, approved availability topology; no distributed workers/HA

areas.name: Data
areas.implemented: Offline snapshot/restore, checksum and artifact validation, session invalidation; resumable run deletion with stale-retry rejection; actual age encryption/verified decryption
areas.remaining: Approved retention policy including historical backups/forks/provider copies, host encryption and recovery-key custody, off-site recovery drill, agreed RPO/RTO

areas.name: Audit / monitoring
areas.implemented: Actor audit records; restricted auditor role; separate durable collector/cursor, restore stream separation, readiness/metrics, recorded outage/rotation/recovery, browser operations view
areas.remaining: Independent retained/WORM custody, actual alert delivery and escalation, collector supervision deployment, service objectives and incident acceptance

areas.name: Deployment
areas.implemented: Locked runtime dependencies, pinned base, hardened container, browser/API checks; actual installed-wheel update/rollback and corruption recovery; current package advisory scans
areas.remaining: Real TLS/DNS environment, identity service, operating owner, target-environment upgrade/rollback and security review

areas.name: Business quality
areas.implemented: Original failures preserved; synthetic comparison paused; actual-source v1 found eight missing Japanese summaries and an age translation error despite passing model review; mandatory output checks and input retrieval added; fixed v22 local-Qwen series retained three interrupted runs and one Docker-gated admission refusal; v23 completed ten actual-source attempts and post-run contract recheck rejected all three completed artifacts for translation drift; v24 completed ten actual-source attempts, with three machine-contract passes, but one retained pass still contained the observed mixed-script terms "ハードネード" and "键轮换与"; v25 completed ten actual-source attempts and rejected every attempt for missing JSON, English or mixed-script summaries, missing anchors, or incomplete rows; v26 completed ten attempts, with one machine-contract pass still containing English labels and malformed Japanese; v27 stopped after one mechanically rejected attempt and an unexpected BrokenPipeError; v28 completed ten attempts, with two machine-contract passes still containing English area labels and glossary drift, so zero runs are accepted; v29 completed ten actual-source attempts, with six machine-contract passes and five Reviewer submissions, but semantic review remains pending and observed English/malformed terminology means zero runs are accepted
areas.remaining: Source/summary correctness, review miss/false-positive evaluation, latency and acceptance thresholds, and a repeat series whose completed outputs remain valid under the strengthened contract

areas.name: Contract / operation
areas.remaining: Owner-approved service scope, SLO/SLA, support and incident responsibility; no invented approvals or certifications
